text:
Gold Price in 2017
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2017, the LBMA gold price rose 6.4% between 2017-01-31 ($1,213) and 2017-12-28 ($1,291). The highest sampled price was $1,312 in August and the lowest was $1,213 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,266. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
